text:
Thanks for your patience, and I'm sorry this has dragged on. Six business days with no tracking movement is past the 4-business-day threshold, so you qualify for a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the package is found to be lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

To open it, please send me your order number (LF-plus six digits). I don't have a way to speed up the investigation beyond that, but if you'd like me to escalate this to a Support Lead, just say so.
